sentences.en: When we borrow money, we must agree on the conditions.
sentences.zh: 当我们借钱时，我们必须同意借款条件。

sentences.en: It has a great many words borrowed from foreign languages.
sentences.zh: 它包含了许多从外语借来的词汇。

sentences.en: I ran all over town trying to borrow some money.
sentences.zh: 我跑遍了整个城镇试图借些钱。
